new_claims.statement: For tau=2^-20, every N3(tau) matrix with s3(A)>=1 has an original-coordinate bipartition L,R whose cross block B has ||B||_F^2>2/3 and falls into exactly one of the paid diffuse-three-volume branch or the quantified R1/R2/R3 survivors in REPORT.md.
If E2(B)<=2^-20, then dist_F(B,rank<=1)<1/590, sigma1(B)>4/5, one top singular vector has squared l_infinity norm <1/296, and one same-side physical block has operator norm >589/590.
If E2(B)>2^-20 but E3(B)<2^-36, then dist_F(B,rank<=2)<1/147.
If E3(B)>=2^-36 and one orientation of the squared 3-minor law has all marginals <=2/3, then Q has a continuous density with ||p_Q||_infinity<=576 sqrt(3e)<1645 for every admissible product law.

If E3(B)>=2^-36 and both row and column volume orientations have a marginal >2/3, then physical row/column anchors and a four-bank coloring retain squared-minor mass >=2^-36/12 across at least 44914 distinct nonzero anchored 3x3 minors.

designated_partner_application.application: The finite-union-core interval inequality P{Q in I}<=576 sqrt(3e)|I| in the diffuse E3 branch transfers with the identical constant to all independent cap-one densities.

remaining_first_implication: QFORM-N3-LOWRANK-OR-ANCHORED-PAYMENT-v1: pay R1, R2 and R3 at arbitrary-self-block scope without deleting small coefficient tails or selecting a single minor.
continuity: PROVED on paid diffuse E3 branch; OPEN on R1/R2/R3 and globally
